instruction: Use the hammer with claw and smooth head to strike the block

source.instruction: Use the hammer with claw and smooth head to strike the block

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the hammer, which was at x = +0 (right half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Rotate left gripper roll to align with hammer handle and move to hover above (0, -8, 94).
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+30, +11, +0) cm, now 3 cm (horizontal) / +16 cm (vertical) from the hammer

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-0, -9, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower left gripper slightly in z to prepare for final descent and grasp.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, -0, -4) cm, now 3 cm (horizontal) / +12 cm (vertical) from the hammer

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-0, -9, 90) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move gripper forward to y=-6.5, lower to z=79 around the handle, and close gripper to grasp hammer.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +2, -11) cm, now 1 cm (horizontal) / -1 cm (vertical) from the hammer; closed the gripper (opening 0.17: holding the hammer)

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-0, -6, 80) opening 0.17; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift hammer up to z=86.5 and retract slightly in y to clear the table surface.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-0, -1, +6) cm, now 1 cm (horizontal) / -1 cm (vertical) from the hammer

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-0, -7, 86) opening 0.18; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift slightly higher and translate left arm towards the block at (-22, -4, 89.5).
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-22, +3, +3) cm, now 1 cm (horizontal) / -1 cm (vertical) from the hammer

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-22, -5, 89) opening 0.18; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Point gripper downwards to align the hammer head for striking the block.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips stayed in place, now 1 cm (horizontal) / -2 cm (vertical) from the hammer

frames.label: turn 7
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-22, -5, 89) opening 0.18; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move slightly left and down to strike the block with the hammer.
